articles.title: Trump reveals millions of dollars' worth of share deals in big tech and AI - BBC
articles.description: Stock in major firms such as Microsoft, Nvidia and SpaceX was bought and sold on behalf of the US president.
articles.content: Across more than 1,000 trades, shares were bought and sold in AI company Nvidia and software firm Palantir, a contractor with the US defence department and Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), … [+16 chars]
